newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TABLE - BASIL READ H1 SHR UP, NO DIV.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - BASIL READ H1 SHR UP, NO DIV.

text.p: Full name: Basil Read Holdings Ltd (building and construction)
NOTE - The company did not declare dividends saying cash would be retained until capital and equity requirements of TRAC are established.
TRAC is a consortium of three construction firms including Basil Read involved in building roads for the Maputo Development Corridor.

Basil Read said most of the assessed losses would be used up by the end of the year, and the group would resume paying income tax on its South African income. The firm added that various long term contracts should be completed during the second half of the year and further improvements are therefore also expected during that period.
